definition: A pack that proportions doors and windows: the shape of the opening and what frames it — its ratio, where its head sits, how it diminishes from storey to storey, how wide its surround is.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's opening-system kind and the opening pack's own statement of what it owns. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, kind description: "opening-system: window and door proportion."; proportions/systems/opening-proportion.json notes: "It owns the RECTANGLE: the ratio of an opening, where its head sits, how it diminishes by storey, how wide its surround is".
